Data extraction: JSON top-level array emits Sequence nodes

```swift title="Swift"
import TreeSitterLanguagePack

let configObj = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.processConfigFromJson("{\"data_extraction\":true,\"language\":\"json\"}")
let result = try TreeSitterLanguagePack.process(source: "[1, 2, 3]", config: configObj)
debugPrint(result.data() as Any)
debugPrint(result.data()?.kind() as Any)
debugPrint(result.data()?.children() as Any)
```
